text: Mo has a red hat.
Mo and a dog sit in the sun.
meaning_zh: 蒙蒙和小狗坐在太陽下。

text: A fox gets the hat!
Mo runs and runs. The fox is hot.
Mo gets the hat. Yes!
Mo has a shell.
A chick and a duck sing.
Ring, ring! It is lunch.
meaning_zh: 叮鈴叮鈴！午餐時間到了。

text: Mo has fish and chips.
Mo, the chick and the duck have fun.
meaning_zh: 蒙蒙、小雞和鴨子玩得好開心。

text: It is night. Mo can see the moon.
meaning_zh: 晚上了，蒙蒙看得到月亮。

text: A bee sits on a leaf.
Then the rain hits the boat.
Mo runs to the house.
Mo reads a book in the chair.
Mo stands on a big rock.
Mo can see a frog and a crab.
meaning_zh: 蒙蒙看到一隻青蛙和一隻螃蟹。

text: The frog jumps. Splash!
The crab claps. Clap, clap!
Mo jumps in and swims.
Mo rides a bike to the lake.
A snake has a big smile.
Mo and the snake have cake.
Five kites fly in the sky.
Mo goes home at nine.
Mo digs a tunnel.
Mo meets a rabbit and a robot.
meaning_zh: 蒙蒙遇到一隻兔子和一個機器人。

text: They have a picnic with lemons.
Then they see a rainbow!
meaning_zh: 接著他們看到一道彩虹！

text: Mo is running and jumping.
Two puppies are playing in the leaves.
The puppies wanted a bigger ball.
Mo smiled and played with them.
meaning_zh: 蒙蒙笑著和牠們一起玩。

text: At night, Mo's friend came to the camp.
meaning_zh: 晚上，蒙蒙的朋友來到營地。

text: The teacher said, look at the stars!
Mo had one banana and some water.
meaning_zh: 蒙蒙吃了一根香蕉、喝了一些水。

text: They walked to the old tree and sang.
